# Hotel Pumerai

> Stay at Hotel Pumerai in Honnavar: 40 rooms, rooftop pool, Matsya and Madhura restaurants, banquet halls and EV charging on NH-66.

## Property Overview
- Hotel Name: Hotel Pumerai
- Star Rating: 3-Star Hotel
- Location: Honnavar, Uttara Kannada, Karnataka, India
- Address: Hotel Pumerai, NH-66, near Ramateertha Cross, Honnavar, Uttara Kannada, Karnataka 581334, India
- Geographic Coordinates: 14.2904652° N, 74.446001° E
- Google Maps Location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/rCfTnw9t8Dp58mga7
- Phone (Reservations): +91 98454 23223
- Front Desk / Landline: 08387-221221
- Email: reservation@hotelpumerai.com
- Official Direct Booking Engine: https://bookingengine.stayflexi.com/?hotel_id=41986
- Total Rooms: 40 Air-Conditioned Rooms & Suites

## Accommodation & Room Categories
1. Club Room with Balcony: 400 sq ft, private glass balcony overlooking the swimming pool, king bed, walk-in rain shower, 50-inch Smart TV.
2. Club Room: Contemporary luxury room, king bed, city and hill vistas, dedicated work desk, rain shower.
3. Deluxe Room: Spacious guestroom, king bed, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, modern bathroom.
4. Premium Room: Elevated comfort, premium bedding, quiet acoustic planning, tea/coffee maker.
5. Family Suite: Two connecting living/sleeping spaces, multiple beds, ideal for families and small groups visiting coastal Karnataka.

## Dining Venues (On-Site)
1. Matsya Multi-Cuisine Restaurant
   - Cuisine: Coastal Karavali seafood, authentic North Indian, tandoor grills, and continental specialties.
   - Operating Hours: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM daily.
   - Service: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner.
2. Madhura Pure Veg Restaurant
   - Cuisine: 100% Pure Vegetarian South Indian tiffins, traditional Karavali meals (thali), and filter coffee.
   - Operating Hours: 6:30 AM – 10:00 PM daily.
   - Service: All-day dining, morning breakfast tiffins.

## Banquet Halls & Event Venues
1. Sidhvin Banquet Hall
   - Capacity: Up to 200 guests.
   - Features: Air-conditioned grand auditorium hall, raised ceremonial stage, presentation dais, audio-visual setup, high-speed Wi-Fi, 100% power backup.
   - Ideal For: Weddings, grand receptions, cultural gatherings, and corporate conventions.
2. Milan Hall
   - Capacity: Up to 50 guests.
   - Features: Intimate air-conditioned hall, round banquet table arrangements, presentation dais, acoustic planning.
   - Ideal For: Private family celebrations, executive meetings, and corporate seminars.

## On-Site Amenities & Facilities
- Glass-edge rooftop swimming pool with adjoining children's splash pool (open daily 6:30 AM – 7:00 PM).
- Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi (100+ Mbps) throughout all rooms and public spaces.
- Free secure covered private parking on premises.
- Dedicated Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations.
- 24-hour front desk and guest concierge reception.
- Dual passenger elevators serving all floors.
- 100% generator power backup and round-the-clock security.
- Centralized air conditioning in all rooms and public venues.

- Kasarkod Eco Beach (Blue Flag Certified): 5 km (8 min drive)
- Honnavar Railway Station: 3.5 km
- Murudeshwar (123-ft Shiva Statue & Temple): 26 km (35 min drive)
- Gokarna (Mahabaleshwar Temple & Om Beach): 48 km (55 min drive)
- Sirsi (Marikamba Temple & Western Ghats Waterfalls): 68 km (1 hr 20 min drive)
- Goa: 125 km (2 hr 30 min drive)
- Udupi: 130 km (2 hr 15 min drive)
- Mangalore: 185 km (3 hr 15 min drive)
